IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for service=runtime, symptom=large kv-cache evictions -> elevated 5xx rate observed. severity=P2. first_event=2003456785

Alex P: seeing it too — 503s across a subset of inference nodes, looks correlated with a spike in cache miss evictions.

Elena (on-call): I'm on it, starting live mitigation diagnostic. noting impacted region: us-west-2.

Mira K: cc @Alex P @Elena — can we confirm customer impact? any SLO breaches yet?

Elena (on-call): early looks: ~3% of requests returned 502/503 for 10m window. Two paying customers saw latency spikes > SLO. No total data loss.

Samir R: label as customer-impacting (partial). Recommend immediate mitigation = throttle eviction aggressiveness + fallback to cold model variant.

Alex P: agreed. applying soft rollback to kv-evict-config now. command:
```bash
kubectl -n inference patch configmap kv-config -p '{"data":{"evict_threshold":"0.8"}}'
```

Chen W: pushing a canary change to 2 nodes first. watching metrics (evict_rate, 5xx_rate, p99).

Elena (on-call): canary shows 5xx rate falling after ~45s. rolling to remaining nodes.

IncidentBot: Mitigation event recorded (runbook: kv-evict-rollback). page_count=1.

Mira K: good. we should still open a post-incident to follow up root cause and remediation. Who can drive the postmortem and scheduling?

Alex P: I can own the postmortem and write the timeline. I'll schedule 60m next week.

Kelsey: I'll take action item for short-term detection improvements (adjust alert thresholds + add a dedicated dashboard). estimate: 1d. priority: high. ties to Q2 observability sprint.

Samir R: I'll own an action to add an automated rollback knob into the operator (so we can decouple manual k8s patch). estimate: 3d (prototype) / 2w (full rollout). priority: medium-high. recommend we slot prototype into sprint week 2 of Q3.

Chen W: follow-up item: investigate root cause for eviction spike — suspect regression in cache admission logic when sequence lengths increased. I'll gather logs, perf traces, and a minimal repro. estimate: 4d. priority: high. ties to inference runtime reliability epic.

Elena (on-call): quick customer outreach: I notified the two affected customers and logged incident ticket refs. Add customer impact notes to postmortem.

Mira K: action items summary for postmortem doc (Alex to author):
- A1: Postmortem doc + timeline (owner: Alex P) — estimate: 2d to draft. severity: P2.
- A2: Short-term alerting/dashboard improvements (owner: Kelsey) — estimate: 1d. severity: P2-high. Q2 tie-in: observability sprint.
- A3: Auto-rollback operator feature (owner: Samir R) — estimate: prototype 3d / full 2w. severity: P3. Q3 candidate.
- A4: Root cause deep-dive and repro (owner: Chen W) — estimate: 4d. severity: P2. roadmap: reliability epic.
- A5: Customer comms follow-up and SLA reconciliation (owner: Elena) — estimate: 0.5d. severity: P2.

Samir R: for prioritization, can we map to severity and quarterly planning: A1/A2/A4 are immediate (Q2 hotfix/retro), A3 is Q3 platform improvement.

Kelsey: I'll add a short JIRA ticket template for A2 with links to the dashboard panels to make rollout fast.

Alex P: scheduling: propose postmortem meeting Wednesday 09:30 PT next week. I'll publish calendar invite after drafting the timeline and attaching logs.

Mira K: ensure the postmortem doc includes an action matrix with owner, estimate, priority, and linked JIRA. we'll use that for sprint planning and to escalate to the PM for Q2 bundling.

Elena (on-call): final on-call notes: mitigation successful, no ongoing customer incidents, continue monitoring for 24h. adding retention of incident logs to case.

IncidentBot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 2003460000. postmortem_required=true.

Alex P: I'll post the initial draft by EOD tomorrow and tag everyone for review. Please flag any additional follow-ups (security, billing, legal) if relevant.

Mira K: thanks team. nice quick mitigation. Let's ensure we size items conservatively when we put them in the quarterly planning board. :thumbsup:

Samir R: quick note for postmortem: include perf histograms around sequence length distribution and KV cache pressure — that was the key signal.

Chen W: will attach a reproduction script and sample logs to the doc. snippet: 
```python
# repro sketch
for seq in varied_seqs:
    client.call(model, seq)
```

Kelsey: adding action items to JIRA now, will link back to this thread.

Alex P: closing with owners repeated: Alex=A1, Kelsey=A2, Chen=A4, Samir=A3, Elena=A5. I'll mark priorities in the doc.

Mira K: thanks all — handoff complete.
